content: Supabase storage buckets default to private, but developers commonly flip a bucket to 'Public' for CDN convenience without realizing this bypasses all access control for both read and write to anyone holding the object URL, and file paths often encode tenant/company IDs so enumeration leaks cross-tenant files. Real incident: 170+ Lovable-built apps in Jan 2025 had exposed anon-readable databases/storage due to missing RLS. Buckets carrying employee attendance photos must stay private with storage RLS policies scoped to company_id membership, never public.
